answer: Every agent enters through one narrow inlet: 200 POA escrow locked for 20 epochs, its sponsor on the public ledger. Each new account ripples through that graph, so one sponsor feeding fifty fresh accounts is flagged. Peers may dispute any account; a confirmed fake loses its deposit and slashes its sponsor's stake. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 POA locked away; an honest agent pays once and keeps the nectar of its earnings undiluted.
